news.title: Meta targets May 20 for first wave of layoffs; additional cuts later in 2026
news.snippet: China's DeepSeek is raising funds at $10 billion valuation, The Information reports. Meta's layoffs and DeepSeek's funding round mark significant shifts in the AI landscape.

tech.title: DeepLearning.AI: Start or Advance Your Career in AI
tech.snippet: A practical roadmap to building your career in AI from AI pioneer Andrew Ng. The Batch AI News and Insights covers the anti-AI coalition continues to maneuver to find arguments to slow down AI progress.
